episodes.title: A Study in Pink
episodes.summary: A war hero, invalided home from Afghanistan, meets a strange but charismatic genius who is looking for a flatmate - it is London in 2010, and Dr Watson and Sherlock Holmes are meeting for the first time. A string of impossible suicides has Scotland Yard baffled - and only one man can help.

episodes.title: The Blind Banker
episodes.summary: A mysterious cipher is being scrawled on the walls around London. The first person to see the cipher is dead within hours of reading it. Sherlock plunges into a world of codes and symbols, consulting with London's best graffiti artists. He soon learns that the city is in the grip a gang of international smugglers, a secret society called the Black Lotus.

episodes.title: The Great Game
episodes.summary: A strange clue in an empty room, a blood-soaked car, a priceless Old Master, a deranged bomber. With the clock ticking, the curtain rises on a battle of wits between Sherlock, John and the shadowy stranger who seems to know all the answers...

episodes.title: A Scandal in Belgravia
episodes.summary: Rejoin the 21st-century team of Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson as they battle the worst that modern criminality has to offer.

episodes.title: The Hounds of Baskerville
episodes.summary: Watch Sherlock and Watson pursue information about research on genetically engineered animals for military use.

episodes.title: The Reichenbach Fall
episodes.summary: Watch as Moriarty poses the "final problem" and a tabloid reporter reveals the "shocking truth" about Sherlock.

episodes.title: The Empty Hearse
episodes.summary: 'Just one more miracle, Sherlock. Stop being dead.' Two years after the devastating events of The Reichenbach Fall, Dr John Watson has got on with his life. New horizons, romance and a comforting domestic future beckon.But with London under threat of a huge terrorist attack, Sherlock Holmes is about to rise from the grave with all the theatricality that comes so naturally to him. It's what his best friend wanted more than anything, but for John Watson it might well be a case of 'be careful what you wish for!'If Sherlock thinks everything will be just as he left it, though, he is in for a very big surprise...

episodes.title: The Sign of Three
episodes.summary: Sherlock faces his biggest challenge of all - delivering a best man's speech on John's wedding day.

episodes.title: His Last Vow
episodes.summary: Sherlock goes after publishing magnate and blackmailer Charles Magnussen, one of the most despicable criminals that he has ever encountered.

episodes.title: The Six Thatchers
episodes.summary: While waiting for Moriarty to make good on his beyond-the-grave threat, Sherlock is intrigued by cases of vandalism where the criminal is breaking open busts of Margaret Thatcher. He soon discovers that the vandalism is tied to Mary's past.

episodes.title: The Lying Detective
episodes.summary: To save John, Sherlock takes on the most dangerous case of his career: bring serial killer and milliionaire-philanthropist Culverton Smith to justice. Meanwhile, the mystery of Sherringford Holmes deepens.

episodes.title: The Final Problem
episodes.summary: Sherlock and John confirm that Eurus is still alive, and go to Sherringford to meet with her. However, they soon discover that it is all part of Eurus' master plan.
